The '''Republic of Raledria''', also known as the '''Raledria''', is a country located in [[Atirha]]. It is a [[Wikipedia:Federal_republic|federal republic]] of ___ states and a [[Wikipedia:Nature_reserve|nature preserve]] district, [[Carion]]. The republic borders [[Genaire]] and [[Arbiya]] to the north, [[Gaeiya]] to the east, [[Curata]] and [[Fincen]] to the south, and [[New Misos]] to the West. It shares jurisdiction of [[Lake Uterri]] with the bordering nations. Raledria also asserts sovereignty over the Republic of [[Arbiya]], with control over their foreign policy. It is a diverse country, with the world's f[[List of countries and dependencies by area|ourteenth-largest land area]] and [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|firth-largest population]], recently exceeding 300 million.

Humans are not native to [[Atirha]]; they [[Discovery of Atirha|stepped foot]] on the continent in 1240 AFA. [[Taval|Tavalan]] exploration and [[Wikipedia:Colonization|colonization]] led to the establishment of [[Itanor]] in 1513 , part of modern day [[Guise]] , the first [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] colony on the continent. Subsequent [[Lycroa|Lycroan]] and [[Emara|Emaran]] colonisation began with the first settlement of the Colonies in the [[Tirna bay]] in 1391. Forced migration of criminals and slaves provided the labor force necessary to make the early [[Wikipedia:Plantation_economy|plantation economy]] of the Colonies economically viable. The weakening of crown control in reaction to the conflicts in [[Ayuma]] during the [[Seniaaii Revolution]], and the heavy taxation that followed, sparked the [[Raledrian Deceleration of Independence|Deceleration of Independence]], with [[Gaeiya]] and Raledria dividing the colonies between the two. formally declaring the republic in 1549. The [[Third treaty of Atirha]] brought international recognition of Raledrian sovereignty, and the country continued to expand North across [[Atirha]]. 

The [[Great Atirhan War]] started between Raledria and [[Gaeiya]] in 1607 over the death of [[King Yap Yap Yap|Gaeiyas King]]. With victory doubling Raledria's size, the newly passed [[Grand Amendment|Amendment]] moved the Capital from [[Zunle]] to [[Tirna]], while also banning [[Wikipedia:Slavery|slavery]] nationally. By 1700, the country had established itself as a great power, a status solidified after its involvement in the [[Great Imperial War]]. Following the [[Misoan attack on (Ship i guess)|Misoan attack]] in 1690, Raledria entered the [[Red War]]. Its aftermath left Raledria and the [[Estijan Huan]] as the world's sole superpowers and led to the start of the [[Cold War]], during which both countries, along with the later inclusion of [[Dahe]], struggled for economic dominance and international influence. The [[Collapse of Estijan Huan|Huan's collapse]] and the end of the Cold War left the Raledria and [[Dahe]], now an ally, as the world's sole superpowers.

(info about how the government is run)

A [[Wikipedia:Developed_country|developed country]], Raledria ranks high in economic competitiveness, productivity, [[Wikipedia:Innovation|innovation]], and higher education. Raledria accounted for over a [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)| sixth of nominal global economic output]] in 2024, and its economy has been the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|world's second largest nominally]] since about 1732. Raledrian [[List of sovereign states by wealth inequality|wealth inequality]] is among the most pronounced in the developed world. A melting pot of many ethnicities and customs, the culture of Raledria has been shaped by centuries of [[Wikipedia:Immigration|immigration]], and its soft power influence has a global reach. Raledria is a member of numerous international organisations and plays a leading role in global political, cultural, economic, and military affairs.
